Indikator 2b measures the completion of an interview or environmental observation for children and adolescents aged 6–17 within the ADHD diagnostic pathway. The national target requires clinics to achieve a specific compliance threshold, yet the national average for Denmark sits at just 51%, missing the target [^src1]. Across regions and specific departments, performance varies drastically, highlighting significant disparities in diagnostic practices and adherence to clinical guidelines.

The leaders in this comparison are [[odense-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Odense: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] and [[bua-smaborn-klinik|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn]], both achieving 94% and successfully meeting their targets [^src1]. [[aabenna-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] also met the target with 93% [^src1]. Conversely, the trailers are predominantly private institutions; [[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]] as a collective category achieved only 7%, with specific Hejmdal Privathospital departments in Aalborg, Odense, and Viby scoring 0% [^src1]. Regionally, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] (32%) and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (39%) are the lowest-performing regions, both missing their targets [^src1].

When examining trends between the 2022/23 and 2023/24 periods, mixed trajectories emerge. The national average improved from 43% to 49%, though it remains below the target [^src1]. [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] saw a notable increase from 17% to 32%, while [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] experienced a sharp decline from 89% to 77% [^src1]. [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] also declined from 43% to 31% over the same period [^src1]. 

Outliers in the data include units with 100% compliance but heavily suppressed or minimal patient volumes (denoted by `#/#`), such as Børne-Unge Psyk. Reg.fkt. 40.R and BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Spiseforstyrrelser [^src1]. Additionally, [[esbjerg-bup-ambulatorium|Esbjerg: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] and [[vejle-bup-ambulatorium|Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] show steep internal regional drops in Syddanmark (75% and 31%, respectively) compared to the high performance of Odense and Aabenraa [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner opfyldelse af Indikator 2b (interview eller miljøobservation for 6–17-årige) på tværs af regioner, afdelinger og privathospitaler i 2024/25, med reference til tidligere år, og viser stor spredning — fra 94–100 % i Odense, Aabenraa, Småbørn og Reg.fkt. 40.R til 0–32 % i flere privathospitaler og regionale enheder.
